objectives.title: Main Character
objectives.description: Be selected by the target spinner 3 times.

objectives.title: Problem Child
objectives.description: Cause 3 extra effects against other players.

objectives.title: Token Dragon
objectives.description: Own 7 tokens at the same time.

hiddenRoles.title: Merchant
hiddenRoles.description: Sells tiny advantages, buys bigger trouble, and skims value from the token economy.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: Token purchases cost 1 point less, with a minimum cost of 1 point. Every shop purchase also counts toward Merchant rewards.

hiddenRoles.title: Bodyguard
hiddenRoles.description: Protect others and get paid for taking risks.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: Gain +1 extra point whenever your bodyguard offer is approved.
hiddenRoles.rewardDescription: Gain a Shield token every 2 approved bodyguard actions.

hiddenRoles.title: Gambler
hiddenRoles.description: Lives for risk and gets rewarded when fate turns nasty.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: When you are hit by High, Brutal, or Deathwish, gain +1/+2/+3 points respectively.
hiddenRoles.rewardDescription: Gain a Forced Double Shock token every 3 High+ outcomes.

hiddenRoles.title: Survivor
hiddenRoles.description: Avoid danger at all costs and profit from staying untouched.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: Gain +1 point for every 3 consecutive rounds where you are not selected.
hiddenRoles.rewardDescription: Gain an Immunity token after avoiding shocks for 5 rounds.

hiddenRoles.title: Cultist
hiddenRoles.description: Serves the Event Deck and profits from chaos.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: Gain +1 point whenever an event card directly affects you.
hiddenRoles.rewardDescription: Gain a Chaos token every 3 event-card effects.

hiddenRoles.title: Saboteur
hiddenRoles.description: Manipulates others and spreads extra suffering.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: Gain +1 point whenever you spend a token or action that targets another player with an extra negative effect.
hiddenRoles.objectiveDescription: Cause 3 extra effects against other players.
hiddenRoles.rewardDescription: Gain a Forced Double Shock token every 3 sabotage effects.

hiddenRoles.title: Hoarder
hiddenRoles.description: Collects tokens and becomes more dangerous the longer the game goes on.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: No token-hoarding penalty; this role is intended to benefit from saving large token piles.
hiddenRoles.objectiveDescription: Own 7 tokens at the same time.
hiddenRoles.rewardDescription: Gain a Blessing token when you reach 7 owned tokens.

hiddenRoles.title: Martyr
hiddenRoles.description: Takes risks for others and gets rewarded for being the noble idiot.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: Gain +2 extra points whenever your bodyguard action is approved.
hiddenRoles.rewardDescription: Gain an Immunity token every 3 redirected/bodyguard hits.

hiddenRoles.title: Chaos Agent
hiddenRoles.description: Wants the table to stop making sense.
hiddenRoles.passiveDescription: Whenever an event card appears, you have a 20% chance to gain +1 point.
hiddenRoles.rewardDescription: Gain a Chaos token every 5 event-card experiences.
